title: External observation admission candidate v1
description: Proposed unsigned producer envelope. Not an enabled public endpoint or a verified EvidenceFact. Identity, resource scope and fact type come from the core-owned binding. The byte decoder also enforces a 65536-byte body limit, unique decoded member names, UTF-8 byte limits, integer JSON tokens for revisions/sequences/timestamps, and no numerical overflow or nonzero underflow.

observed_at_ms.description: Producer observation time, Unix milliseconds. Retries retain this original value.

effective_at_ms.description: Time at which the unsigned producer attests the state was effective, Unix milliseconds; must not exceed observed_at_ms. Use the provider event time when available. A source without an event timestamp may use an explicitly opted-in as-of-read time only with provenance in the core-approved claim contract; it must never be presented as a provider event timestamp. No timestamp or provenance claim grants verification or issuance authority.

claims.description: Only primitive unsigned claims. The admission kernel additionally applies the exact administrator-approved claim allowlist, types, numeric ranges, UTF-8 byte lengths and reserved-name exclusions. JSON schema alone does not grant trust.
